Q2: The repository confirms the cause. `_clone_for_memory_branch` (`scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3208-3224`) runs a full `git clone --no-tags --quiet <origin>` on every write and only then fetches `ai-memory`. The only job in `.github/workflows/memory_maintenance.yml` has `timeout-minutes: 20` (line 14). The extraction step (lines 65-66) is `continue-on-error: true` but has no step timeout, so a slow extraction takes up the whole 20 minutes and the job is cancelled. The step timeout alone gives only a thin margin, which shrinks as the repository grows. The single-branch clone removes the cause itself. Doing both, each with its own regression test, fixes the cause and makes the fail-open step actually fail open.
